entities.summary: Petroșani is a city in Hunedoara County, Transylvania, Romania, with a population of 31,044 as of 2021. The city has been associated with mining since the 19th century. Petroșani is a city in Eastern Europe, established around 1640. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
